purpose: Pinned Chromium source and Thor-owned downstream build inputs.

privacy: native global browser-history saving disabled by default
native third-party cookie blocking with Privacy Sandbox Topics, Protected Audience/FLEDGE, ad measurement, and Related Website Sets disabled by default
native DNT with search suggestions, translation offers, preloading, alternate error pages, and hyperlink auditing disabled by default
native managed GPC with Sec-GPC request signaling and Window/WorkerNavigator API exposure
native New Identity action with one memory-only OTR profile per disposable window
native Destroy Identity action requesting closure of every window bound to the selected disposable profile
native strict origin isolation by default
native conservative cleanup of known tracking parameters on outermost GET navigations
native DevHost, Stealth, and Hardened dangerous-API defaults with Hardened JIT disable
native target-profile WebGL debug renderer reduction (bounded anti-fingerprinting surface)
